notes: Ten ordinary requests, one or two per kind of work. They are questions to ask a model, not answers to check. scripts/run_baseline_gate.py appends them to the eight core briefs to form the `extended` set. `mode` names the kind of request for the reader; the skill itself no longer classifies requests.

prompts.prompt: Design a home screen for a budgeting app.
Design a medication reminder home screen for a patient-facing health app.
Design a product listing screen for a secondhand marketplace app.
Map the onboarding flow for a habit-tracking app, from install to the first completed habit.
Create a platform-aware UI spec for a package tracking detail screen on Android.
Create a UI spec for an iPad clinician chart review screen in a hospital EHR app.

Review this settings screen: a single scrolling list of 18 toggles with no grouping, a Delete account row in the same visual style as the others, and a Save button at the bottom. No screenshot is available.
Create a mobile type and spacing system for a personal finance app with dense transaction screens.
Prepare the design rationale and handoff notes for a redesigned appointment booking confirmation screen in a healthcare app.
Help me design our paywall pricing architecture — how many tiers, what gates which feature, where the upgrade prompts live across the app, and how we handle downgrade.
